name: my-pi-harness
description: Local-first PC agent harness built independently on Pi

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tests/e2e/tsconfig.json --noEmit && turbo run typecheck
scripts.lint: eslint . && pnpm lint:a11y && node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/check-source-conventions.mjs && node scripts/check-docs.mjs && pnpm version:check
scripts.test:m3: vitest run packages/agent-runtime/test/context-budget.test.ts packages/agent-runtime/test/context-rules.test.ts packages/agent-runtime/test/start-cancellation.test.ts packages/agent-runtime/test/work-runtime.test.ts packages/agent-runtime/test/context-pipeline.test.ts packages/agent-runtime/test/context-review-regressions.test.ts packages/storage/test/context-work.test.ts packages/storage/test/session-jsonl.test.ts packages/storage/test/attachment-blobs.test.ts packages/storage/test/session-log-directory.test.ts apps/daemon/test/attachments.test.ts apps/daemon/test/work-api.test.ts apps/web/test/context-work.test.ts apps/web/test/question-answers.test.ts apps/web/test/context-versions.test.ts apps/web/test/attachment-input.test.ts apps/web/test/work-service.test.ts && playwright test tests/e2e/m3.spec.ts
scripts.test:m2: vitest run packages/execution/test packages/agent-runtime/test/tool-runtime.test.ts packages/storage/test/tools.test.ts packages/storage/test/workspaces.test.ts apps/daemon/test/workspaces.test.ts apps/daemon/test/workspaces-api.test.ts apps/desktop/test/security.test.ts apps/desktop/test/preload.test.ts apps/web/test/timeline-entries.test.ts apps/web/test/workspace-directory.test.ts apps/web/test/workspace-tree.test.ts && playwright test tests/e2e/m2.spec.ts tests/e2e/m2-completion.spec.ts tests/e2e/workspace-creation.spec.ts
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.package:desktop: pnpm build && node scripts/prepare-desktop.mjs && pnpm --filter @my-pi-harness/desktop package
